narrative.executive_summary: Across 11 live missions, the platform exhibits no single critical outage but a systemic inventory control failure that masks imminent stockout risk. 21 high-velocity products driving ₹505,881 in cumulative sales (213 units) are simultaneously flagged for immediate replenishment with 0 units of recommended reorder volume, indicating complete reorder point calibration failure (risk score 47). Concentration risk is acute with Oil (42 units), Biscuits (30 units), and Mouse (28 units) dominating demand, amplifying supplier fragility, while margin analysis shows compression to a 32.7% blended margin (₹152,500 profit on ₹466,989 sales). Without immediate intervention, lost sales on top velocity SKUs and accelerating margin erosion will compound within this cycle.

threat_vectors.name: Systemic Reorder Point & Replenishment Failure
threat_vectors.description: Three independent missions flag 21 products for immediate replenishment yet recommend 0 units reorder volume, with calibration failure scoring 47/100. The automated system is blind to actual stockout risk, guaranteeing lost sales on high-velocity SKUs.

threat_vectors.name: High-Velocity Supplier Concentration Fragility
threat_vectors.description: 36 high-velocity products identified, with 21 core SKUs driving the majority of revenue; Oil (42 units), Biscuits (30 units), and Mouse (28 units) are single points of failure. Any disruption in this cluster directly threatens ₹505,881 in sales and continuity.

threat_vectors.name: Margin Compression from Cost Creep
threat_vectors.description: Profit analysis across 15 high-velocity items shows total profit of ₹152,500.18 on ₹466,989 sales, with top contributor Mouse at only 29.49% margin (₹39,496). Sourcing cost arbitrage signals across 15 products (risk scores 35-43) confirm unchecked cost creep eroding profitability.

immediate_actions: Override automated reorder logic within 24 hours: manually calculate and place emergency reorder volumes for the 21 flagged high-velocity SKUs, prioritizing Oil (42 units), Biscuits (30), Mouse (28), and Sugar (23).
Audit and recalibrate reorder point, safety stock, and lead-time formulas across all 36 high-velocity products to resolve the zero-volume anomaly and validate against actual sales velocity.
Initiate buffer stock and dual-sourcing for top 4 velocity leaders to de-risk supplier fragility before next replenishment cycle.
Execute rapid cost renegotiation on the 15 margin-analyzed SKUs, starting with Mouse and sub-30% margin items to halt margin compression.
Quarantine and disposition the 13 dead stock items from Legacy Graveyard to free working capital and prevent replenishment resources being diverted from velocity drivers.
monitoring_recommendations: Deploy daily velocity vs. stock-on-hand dashboard with hard alert when 'requires replenishment' flag triggers with 0 recommended units.
Implement weekly margin and sourcing cost variance tracking for top 15 profit contributors, flagging any >3% cost increase or margin drop below 30%.
Establish continuous supplier health and lead-time monitoring for the 21-SKU high-velocity cluster with bi-weekly inventory fragmentation audits.
